subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should large native message bodies use nested scrolling, or should iOS and Android adopt an explicit full-message reader similar to the WebChat direction?
rationale: Both approaches address tall messages, but they have materially different gesture, accessibility, discoverability, and cross-platform behavior that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Add a full-message reader
options.body: Keep transcript scrolling primary and give tall or truncated native messages a clear action that opens their complete content in a dedicated bounded surface.

options.title: Use nested body scrolling
options.body: Make every large native bubble body independently scrollable and validate gesture handoff, accessibility, streaming, attachments, and tool results on both platforms.

recommendation.title: Add a full-message reader
recommendation.body: Keep transcript scrolling primary and give tall or truncated native messages a clear action that opens their complete content in a dedicated bounded surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Already provided the product-facing review on this issue and has relevant native release history.
